_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored - it is your machine,
not the design. Every script reads this file; nothing else should hardcode a
username, a repository, or machine sizing.
The three-zone split is the opinionated default. Rename them if you like, but
read decisions/0001 before collapsing or adding zones - the boundary is the
point, and 'external' existing at all is most of the value.

wsl._comment: null means derive from this machine. Set a number to pin it.

daily._comment: Your existing general-purpose distro. Keeps /mnt/c, loses interop. Set to null to skip.

zones._comment: uid MUST be unique across every distro including daily - see decisions/0016.
zones.name: work

zones._comment: Holds no credentials on purpose. github:false is asserted by verify.sh.
zones.name: external

_reposFormat: Each entry is either "owner/name", or an object when the local directory
should differ from the repository name, or when it must be cloned without
credentials (required for the external zone, which has no gh login):
